activity_summary: The four lines that went with the canvas say that the king is played on Thursday, and that there will be more when you know whether anybody came. They do not describe the tooth. They do not mention the Mayor. They do not guess the house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the four lines, and did not add a fifth.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Not in the room. The page goes with the canvas.

entities.name: the carrier
entities.context: Mentioned in Four lines for Anne
